verdict.rationale: Buzz is an agent-first team chat, so AI recaps of missed channels and threads is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never documents a summary or recap feature. Agents searching history and posting threads (buzz-gh-3) is retrieval, not summarization. The personalized feed (buzz-docs-14) is a different feature, and the @mention agent harness (buzz-docs-10) is only a building block a user could prompt to summarize.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get AI-generated summaries and recaps of channels and threads I missed
